blocks.text: House Cleanout Services in Brampton, Ontario — Built for Houses That Held More Than Most

c: Brampton houses work harder than the average home. Three generations under one roof, a second kitchen downstairs, a basement suite with its own front door, a garage doing double duty as storage — so when the day comes to empty one, there’s simply more of everything. That’s the job we’re sized for. One free walkthrough, one flat all-inclusive quote, and a fully insured crew that clears every floor, every suite and every corner — sorted, hauled and swept, usually in a single visit.

blocks.text: Bramalea to Mount Pleasant — When Brampton Empties a House, We Get the Call

The city's houses span half a century of family life: original Bramalea sections where homes have held the same family since the seventies, busy streets in Springdale and Castlemore where households run at full capacity, and newer builds in Mount Pleasant already on their second owners. Live Junk Free clears them all — 660+ five-star Google reviews earned on full houses, honest flat quotes and finish dates that held.

items.title: More stuff means more truck — never more games

blocks.text: Pricing is volume, start to finish. A garage is a small load; a full multigenerational home with a finished basement might be several — and it's quoted as exactly that, one flat figure, before a single box moves. No hourly billing, no per-room pricing, no difference between Brampton postal codes.

items.title: Full houses get walked, not estimated

blocks.text: A phone call can't see the second kitchen, the suite downstairs, the storage under the stairs or the loft above the garage — and in Brampton, those spaces are never empty. We quote after walking all of it with you. Free, in person, and firm once given.

Crew, trucks, fuel, disposal fees, donation runs — one number holds it all. When the basement turns out to hold a household of its own (it usually does), that's already inside the price. Nothing discovered mid-job can raise it.

items.title: Houses full of family get cleared like it

blocks.text: Multigenerational homes hold multigenerational things: documents in more than one language, wedding gold, photographs spanning continents, tools and keepsakes that crossed oceans to get here. We sort as we clear, set aside everything that looks like it matters, and let the family decide — because a crew that shovels first and asks later has no business in a home like this.

Frequently Asked Questions About House Cleanouts in Brampton, ON

items.q: Q: How much does a full house cleanout cost in Brampton?
a: A: Volume is the whole formula. Small loads start at $125, garages and basements land mid-range, and complete homes — including basement suites — are quoted as one flat, locked figure at your free walkthrough. Hours, effort and surprises inside the house never move an approved price.

items.q: Q: Our house has a basement suite with its own entrance. Can both levels be cleared in one visit?
a: A: That’s the standard Brampton job for us. Both levels ride as one combined load with one price — always cheaper than two bookings — and suite contents exit through the suite’s own entrance, so anyone living upstairs barely notices the work below.

items.q: Q: The house held three generations. How long will this realistically take?
a: A: Most Brampton homes — even genuinely full ones — clear in a single day, with trucks cycling as needed. The heaviest multigenerational houses occasionally need a second day, and if yours is one of them you’ll hear it plainly at the walkthrough, not as a surprise at sunset.

items.q: Q: There are important things mixed in — documents, gold, family photos. How is that protected?
a: A: By sorting instead of shovelling, on every load. Papers, jewelry, photographs, cash and anything that looks significant goes into a set-aside collection reviewed with your family before its fate is decided. In homes with this much history, we assume the precious is hiding among the ordinary — it always is.

items.q: Q: A tenant left our rental house full of belongings. Can you clear it?
a: A: Yes — once you’ve met Ontario’s requirements around a former tenant’s property, we clear the house completely, document with photos if you’d like a record, and hand back a swept property ready to re-rent or list. Brampton landlords call us for exactly this all the time.
